Doctor and Wife Attacked in Sleep; Doctor Dies

A doctor in Pittsburgh was killed while sleeping, and his wife was also attacked during the incident. Police stated that an intruder allegedly attacked the couple as they slept. The doctor, who was described as "loved by all" and "kind, compassionate, caring," died from stab wounds. The circumstances surrounding the attack and the identity of the intruder remain under investigation.
